instructions.description: Stand facing the cable with elbows bent and close to the sides.
Press the handle downward by straightening the elbows.
Pause without forcefully locking the joints.
Allow the elbows to bend slowly back to the start.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Cable Triceps Pressdown — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Cable Triceps Pressdown — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
